privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.location_notice: Location is used on your device to show your position on the Camino.
privacy.location_consent_body: Easy Camino uses your location on this device to show where you are on the Camino. Your location is not sent to Easy Camino.
privacy.stage_session_detail: While recording a stage ("On the way") your position and the distance walked are saved only on this device (its local storage) — never on a server.
privacy.routing_detail: Walking directions to your accommodation only send the two points needed to calculate the route (your position and the accommodation) — never a history of your movements.
